text:
maya: Quick heads-up — we're rolling out a set of billing and quota updates effective 2026-05-01. Short summary + links below. Will email customers and post console banners next week.

samir: TL;DR: 1) Free trial credits for NEW accounts reduced ($150 -> $75). Existing credits unchanged. 2) Introduce a short-lived 'burst credit' bucket to absorb traffic spikes. 3) Overage grace window shortened from 14 days to 7 days. 4) Invoices will include per-model/per-route line itemization by default. 5) Default steady rate limits + burst allowances (see below).

elena: what exactly is the "burst credit"? will it affect rate limiting for devs? :thinking_face:

maya: Burst credit = ephemeral credit pool on new/active accounts to prevent accidental small spikes from producing immediate overage charges. It does NOT change your steady rate limit; it only prevents billing until usage stabilizes above thresholds.

samir: New rate defaults (hosted API): steady quota = 120 requests/min per API key; burst allowance = up to 600 RPM sustained for up to 60s. Token-based quotas remain enforced separately. These are conservative defaults; org admins can request raises via the console.

ryan: For Dedicated/Private customers — will invoices and grace windows change? Our tenants have contract terms.

maya: Dedicated customers on active contracts: no change to contract terms. Private (VPC/on-prem) customers: new invoice itemization is available but opt-in; we won't flip contract billing behavior without a revision.

ops-bot: Notice: billing-service v2.3.1 scheduled rollout 2026-04-28 22:00 UTC. Expected short job for invoice recalculation; monitoring page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/bs-210.

billing-bot: Automated summary: Changes queued -> free_credit_adj, burst_bucket_enabled, invoice_line_items_enabled. Migration jobs will run during low-traffic window.

elena: where's the public FAQ / customer-facing copy?

maya: Draft FAQ and customer email templates here: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/billing/2026-apr-change. Excerpt for console banner: "Billing update effective 2026-05-01: updated free credits, burst protection, and clearer invoice line items. Learn more -> [link]"

samir: A couple of implementation notes for eng folks: 1) We will add a new invoice field `burst_consumed` and per-model `line_items`. 2) Usage webhook will include `quota_state` values: NORMAL / BURST / OVERAGE.

ryan: Request: add a webhook event when a key hits 80% of steady quota (not just 100%). Ops needs earlier alerts.

samir: Good call. We'll add `quota_alert.level=warning` at 80% to the webhook roadmap.

lina: Can PMs get a ready-to-send template for customer outreach?

maya: Yes — I'll push templates tomorrow, and schedule a comms mock review Wednesday.

elena: One more — will the console show estimated monthly spend change after burst usage? customers hate surprises.

samir: Console will show a burst preview line in usage UI and an estimate column on invoices for the first billing cycle post-change. We'll include explainer text.

ryan: Any SLA changes?
maya: No SLA changes. This is strictly billing/quota policy and UI.

samir: Roadmap for next two weeks: email -> console banner -> billing-service rollout -> webhook & webhook docs -> docs FAQ updated.

maya: Thanks all. If you need the legal wording, cc @legal in the doc. Will follow up with scheduled meeting for CS templates. :thumbsup:

elena: ack :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Sent customer-notice draft to mailbox queue at 2026-04-20T16:00:00Z.
